title.en: Core Concept of Public Sector Banks
title.hi: Core Concept of Public Sector Banks

content.en: Public Sector Banks are banks where the **Government of India** holds more than 50% of the share capital. These institutions serve as the primary vehicles for implementing government welfare schemes, such as **Financial Inclusion** and **Direct Benefit Transfer**. They are regulated by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** under the Banking Regulation Act.
